description: Erection of a roof extension to provide an additional floor level
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1749-BG-ZZ-02-DR-A-20.203/PO2, Received 8 October 2019; 1749-BG-ZZ-ZZ-DR-A-20.271/PO6, Received 10 October 2019 and 749-BG-ZZ-00-DR-A-00.101/PO1 received 24 April 2019; and RPS Transport Statement (Appendix C - Units 9 & 10 Proposed Parking Arrangements plan) received 24 April 2019)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The extension hereby approved shall only be used for B1, B2 and B8 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) and for no other purpose or use without further permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - 
Before the extension hereby permitted is first occupied, full details of the proposed cycle parking spaces, in a convenient, covered and secure location with stands that are not vertical or semi-vertical in nature shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The facilities as approved shall then be provided at the site at all times.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the occupation of the development, details of the location of proposed electric vehicle charging points/bays shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. At least two of the electric vehicle parking bays shall provide electric vehicle charging points capable of an output of at least 7.2kW and a further bay shall all be provided with a passive provision before the development is brought into use. The electric vehicle charging points/bays shall be retained for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the information submitted as part of the planning application, before the proposed car parking spaces hereby approved are laid out or reconfigured in the manner shown on the approved plans, a hard and soft landscaping scheme shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The scheme shall show replacement tree and shrub planting and details and materials of all the hard surfaces to be provided in the north and south forecourt areas, including details of drainage and the use of porous surfaces for the new hard standing to be created, such that there will be no increase in water run-off to the public surface water drainage system.
